name: kchess
description: A desktop chess app: play Stockfish, play on Lichess, follow friends, review games.
author: Ketan Singrole

scripts.app: pnpm run build && node tooling/with-branded-electron.mjs electron apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter ./apps/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @kchess/rules typecheck && pnpm --filter @kchess/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @kchess/native typecheck && pnpm --filter @kchess/node typecheck && pnpm --filter @kchess/cli typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --mac dir --arm64
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run test:chess && pnpm run test:puzzles && node --experimental-strip-types tooling/main-smoke.ts
scripts.test:core: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:packages && node tooling/core-smoke.mjs && node tooling/node-core-smoke.mjs && node tooling/core-types-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:linux: node tooling/linux.mjs sh -c "pnpm run build && xvfb-run --auto-servernum pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm exec electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --dir --publish never && xvfb-run --auto-servernum pnpm run test:packaged"
scripts.check:rust-lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --lib --locked -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used && cargo clippy -p kchess-voice --bins --locked -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used && cargo clippy -p kchess-service --bins --locked -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used && cargo clippy -p kchess-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.cli: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:packages && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js
